config_files.notes: Primary configuration file storing graphics scalability, display resolution, frame rate limits, photosensitivity toggles, and DLSS/FSR settings under [/Script/Dominion.DominionUserSettings] and [ScalabilityGroups].
Engine-level Unreal Engine 5 configuration. Used for applying aspect ratio axis constraints (AspectRatio_MaintainYFOV) for ultrawide (21:9 and 32:9) display FOV correction.

keys.notes: Often defaults to lower or non-native resolutions on ultrawide monitors. Should match native display width.

keys.effect: Camera shake triggered during combat impacts, dragon roar encounters, and environmental spells.
keys.notes: Recommended False for photosensitivity and motion comfort to avoid jarring camera jolts.

keys.effect: Enables NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency pipeline to reduce system latency.
keys.notes: Only applies on NVIDIA RTX graphics cards. Reduces input lag without performance penalty.
Setting 5 selects DLSS on NVIDIA GPUs. On AMD/Intel hardware, select FSR (2) or XeSS (4).
Quality (4) provides crisp native-level image reconstruction on 1440p and ultrawide displays.
Recommended 0 for photosensitivity to suppress high-contrast light bursts from magic and dragon breath.
Disabling reduces perceptual eye strain and improves clarity across wide panoramic viewpoints.

keys.effect: Unreal Engine 5 Nanite virtualised micro-polygon geometry.
keys.notes: Significantly increases geometric fidelity on high-end GPUs. Disable on mid-range or VRAM-constrained systems.

keys.effect: Controls Unreal Engine FOV scaling behavior: AspectRatio_MaintainYFOV maintains vertical FOV, preventing 'Vert-' image cropping on ultrawide monitors.
keys.notes: Essential tweak for 21:9 and 32:9 displays. Without this, UE5 crops the top and bottom of the camera view, creating a zoomed-in perspective.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: High or Epic on RTX 4070 / RX 7800 XT and above. Medium on lower tiers.
manual_only_settings.reason: Unreal Engine 5 Lumen lighting is compute intensive. Dropping from Epic to High preserves 60FPS+ in dense settlements.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Center HUD or adjust UI scale if available in current build.
manual_only_settings.reason: UE5 UI widgets anchor to display edges; adjusting UI scale helps keep HUD elements within comfortable sightlines on ultrawide.

notes: RuneScape: Dragonwilds is an open-world survival crafting spin-off released by Jagex in September 2026, built on Unreal Engine 5.
Dedicated server configuration is stored separately in DedicatedServer.ini (Steam AppID 4019830).
On ultrawide and super ultrawide monitors (21:9 and 32:9), adding AspectRatio_MaintainYFOV to Engine.ini prevents the default Vert- camera crop.
